customer_acme_inc: Hey team, /v1/tools/exec is returning 400 schema errors intermittently. I pasted the args from a Windows doc and it used to work. Example I pasted below.

customer_acme_inc: ```json
{"tool": "shell.exec", "args": {"cmd": "echo hello",},}
```

alex_support: Thanks — can you share the request_id and raw body (unmodified)?

customer_acme_inc: request_id: req_01HxyzABC123. Raw body I pasted: ```{"tool": "shell.exec", "args": {"cmd": "C:\\Program Files\\run.bat\r\n",},}```

alex_support: That payload has trailing commas after the cmd field and the args object. Also the pasted CRLF (\r\n) and maybe a BOM or curly quotes from Word can break the parser.

raj_eng: From logs we see: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 58` followed by schema validation: `additional properties not allowed` (internal sanitizer flagged). The root cause appears to be malformed JSON (trailing commas + Windows CRLF + smart quotes). Are you using our HTTP API directly or one of the SDKs?

customer_acme_inc: curl from PowerShell, copying payload from a Teams message / Word doc.

alex_support: Quick repro I ran on a Win VM: paste into a file and `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @payload.json` -> 400 with the same parse error. If you run `node -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(require('./payload.json')))"` it fails to parse.

raj_eng: Short-term mitigation: remove trailing commas and convert curly quotes to straight quotes, normalize CRLF -> LF. Example sanitized payload: ```json
{"tool": "shell.exec", "args": {"cmd": "C:\\Program Files\\run.bat"}}
```

syntax-bot: Suggestion: we can implement client-side preflight sanitizer: trim BOM, replace U+201C/U+201D/U+2018/U+2019 -> ' or ", collapse CRLF to \n, and fail with a clearer message if trailing commas remain.

raj_eng: I've opened PR #452 to add a small sanitizer in the JS and Python SDKs and to sharpen the API error to: `400 Malformed JSON: unescaped control characters or trailing commas detected`. Added unit tests covering pasted Windows CRLF + BOM + smart quotes.

miriam_sre: Also rolled a tolerant parser into the hosted intake that will accept trailing commas for 24h and emit a deprecation trace so clients get a clear error to update.

customer_acme_inc: Applied the local sanitization and retried — now 200 OK and job queued. Thanks for the quick help!

alex_support: Glad it worked. We'll leave the issue open until sanitizer PR merges and we verify a week of telemetry. :thumbsup:

customer_acme_inc: Thanks all, appreciate the fast turnaround.
